common_findings: N2,J1 modestly prefer F03; N1,N3,J2 tie, all medium confidence. Both conditional results are valid. F03 integrates error and repair into a sequential account of joint evidence and specifies one testable residual process hypothesis. F05 more completely distinguishes accurate current detection, historical transport, common-time inventory and coverage. Neither establishes the real process/transition assumptions or historical priority.

remaining_issues.F03: Actual shared reliability between the semantic control and target judgment is unestablished. Report-based support is not all philosophical support. The audience test distinguishes restricted processes, not metaphysical truth; stable reasoning can also instantiate a false constitutive account. Independent reasons and confounds remain open.
remaining_issues.F05: No calibrated human transition routine established. The coached-vision controversy must actually project to the same earlier target for the proposed diagnosis to apply. Retained information/extended awareness can license another route. Probabilistic itemwise warrant does not automatically license a reliable conjunction; correlated errors need a further account.

coordinator_text_check: Reread F03 sections6–7 and F05 sections3–4. F03 labels the audience manipulation proposed rather than completed and accepts independent theoretical support. F05 distinguishes historical projection from population/routine generalization and does not infer no evidence from mere underdetermination. Prior arithmetic/source checks retained.
decision: Two preferences and three ties support only a slight F03 advantage. Do not report a decisive win or an empirical finding about essence/consciousness.
